answer: Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, released only after three unrelated confirmations, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. What survives to the nadir is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Work waits on the kernel until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the harbor of the next round.
